item.title: Fine-Tuning π0 (Pi-Zero) for robotic manipulation on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod EKS
item.description: Introduction This post demonstrates how to fine-tune π0 (Pi-Zero), a 3-billion parameter flow matching Vision-Language-Action model from Physical Intelligence, on robot manipulation datasets using Amazon SageMaker HyperPod with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) orchestration. Two standard robotics benchmarks provide the training data: DROID for real-world manipulation and LIBERO-10 for simulated tabletop tasks, with a […]
